mapper.insert: INSERT INTO dashboard_layout (owner_id, name, description, is_default, grid_config, shared_with) VALUES (#{ownerId}, #{name}, #{description}, #{isDefault}, COALESCE(#{gridConfig},'{"columns":12,"row_height":80}')::jsonb, #{sharedWith,typeHandler=kr.co.ircp.cms.domain.media.mapper.StringArrayTypeHandler})
mapper.update: UPDATE dashboard_layout SET name = #{name}, description = #{description}, grid_config = #{gridConfig}::jsonb, shared_with = #{sharedWith,typeHandler=kr.co.ircp.cms.domain.media.mapper.StringArrayTypeHandler}, updated_at = NOW() WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.select: SELECT id, owner_id, name, description, is_default, grid_config::text AS grid_config, shared_with, created_at, updated_at FROM dashboard_layout WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.update: UPDATE dashboard_layout SET is_default = FALSE WHERE owner_id = #{ownerId} AND is_default = TRUE
UPDATE dashboard_layout SET is_default = #{isDefault}, updated_at = NOW() WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO dashboard_layout_widget (layout_id, widget_id, instance_id, position, config_override, sort_order) VALUES (#{layoutId}, #{widgetId}, #{instanceId}, #{position}::jsonb, COALESCE(#{configOverride},'{}')::jsonb, #{sortOrder})
mapper.select: SELECT layout_id, widget_id, instance_id, position::text AS position, config_override::text AS config_override, sort_order FROM dashboard_layout_widget WHERE layout_id = #{layoutId} ORDER BY sort_order ASC, instance_id ASC
